newsitem.title: USA: CME open interest hits record high Monday.
newsitem.headline: CME open interest hits record high Monday.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange said open interest on the exchange reached a record high 7,257,167 contracts on Monday, surpsasing the previous record of 7,251,018 set on June 13, 1996.
The exchange also said year-to-date trading volume through April 30 was running 5.6 percent ahead of last year's pace.
CME officials attributed the growth to increased volatility in U.S. equity and foreign exchange markets and greater uncertainty about interest rates.
They also credited initiatives including the introduction of euroyen contracts, Eurodollar midcurve options and new trading procedures for execution of large orders in foreign currencies.
"I am hopeful that these factors signal the beginning of a new expansionary trend at the Merc," CME Chairman Emeritus Leo Melamed said in a statement.
